editorial.summary: A 3:26 edited art-making monologue that argues creativity and vulnerable expression precede craft. A food detour uses all-fifty-state travel and Adam Perry Lang’s barbecue as subjective proof that care can be felt in an object; the speaker then returns to paint curing, texture and caring as the secret ingredient. The conclusion distinguishes later learnable craft from raw expression and openly describes internal battle, possible crippling depression, suicidal thoughts, not wanting to live, crawling out of bed, showing up, self-care and deserving to be present. Reprises, music, profanity, masks and every difficult idea remain. Rankings, creativity/religion claims, metaphors, depression language and coping action remain attributed philosophy/self-report—not fact, diagnosis or treatment.
